outcome: Morbidity (nosocomial infections, bronchopulmonary dysplasia, retinopathy of prematurity, intraventricular hemorrhage)
cohort: 2672 preterm infants born at <35 weeks gestational age requiring mechanical ventilation for >24 hours
finding: Preterm infants exposed to narcotics and/or sedatives during mechanical ventilation had higher rates of mortality/morbidity and longer durations of ventilation compared to unexposed infants.
